title: Server tool-group extraction Phase 2
claim: FP-MCP-352 Phase 2 completed a behavior-preserving extraction of four read-only validation/preflight MCP tools from src/server.ts into a validation tool group without changing the registered tool surface.
summary: Copilot performed the second bounded MCP bridge refactor phase in /home/ridasaidd/forgepilot-chatgpt-mcp only. The phase moved forgepilot_validate_opencode_run_request, forgepilot_validate_remote_runner_request, forgepilot_validate_scoped_execution_clearance, and forgepilot_validate_execution_preflight into src/tool-groups/validation-tools.ts and updated src/tool-registry/index.ts plus src/server.ts delegation. Verification showed pnpm test passed and full selected tool-registration parity remained 68 -> 68 with identical sorted names, no additions, no removals, and no duplicates. Bridge commit f3a9063 records the implementation.
caveats: This was Phase 2 only, not a complete server.ts normalization.
forgepilot_validate_remote_runner_endpoint_request intentionally remained in server.ts because it is external-contact/openWorld validation.
forgepilot_evaluate_consuming_action_no_contact intentionally remained in server.ts because it is not read-only and may write a readiness artifact.
The running MCP service may still be using old loaded code until the service is restarted/refreshed; this checkpoint records source-level implementation and verification only.
The bridge branch remains ahead of origin until pushed manually.
